info.name: AlMomiaa Enterprise ERP API (v1)
info.description: Complete categorized Postman v2.1 collection covering all 8 ERP modules, authentication, per-column validation payloads, ZATCA Phase 2 invoicing, double-entry finance, dashboards, and audit logs. Run folders 01 -> 10 in order to automatically chain IDs via environment variables.

item.name: 01 - Auth & Health
item.description: Health check and JWT + HttpOnly refresh-cookie authentication lifecycle.

request.description: Anonymous liveness check. Returns HTTP 200 `{ "status": "Healthy" }`.

Authenticates an active employee using phone or employee code. Issues a 10-minute JWT (`accessToken`) and sets the HttpOnly `almomiaa_refresh` cookie. Automatically saves `{{accessToken}}` and `{{currentUserId}}`.
Rotates the `almomiaa_refresh` HttpOnly cookie and issues a fresh 10-minute Bearer JWT. Requires a trusted `Origin` header matching `Cors:AllowedOrigins`.
Revokes the current refresh session family and clears the `almomiaa_refresh` cookie (HTTP 204).

item.name: 02 - Users & Roles (IAM)
item.description: Employee provisioning, activation/deactivation, and role permission management.

request.description: Requires `users:manage`. Supports optional `search`, `roleCode`, `isActive`, `page`, `pageSize`.

item.name: Create Sales Rep User (with CashVan Auto-Provision)

request.description: Requires `users:manage`. Creates a new employee (`Password` >= 10 chars with upper, lower, digit, special). Saves `{{repUserId}}` and `{{vanWarehouseId}}`.
Requires `users:manage`. Returns employee profile, assigned roles, assigned warehouses, and computed `effectivePermissions`.
Requires `users:manage`. Deactivating a user (`isActive: false`) rotates their SecurityStamp and immediately revokes active JWTs.

item.name: Create Custom Role with Specific Permissions

request.description: Requires `permissions:manage` (`SUPER_ADMIN`). Creates a custom role with an exact subset of canonical permission claims. Saves `{{customRoleId}}`.

item.name: Assign / Replace Roles on User (Grant Permissions)

request.description: Requires `permissions:manage` (`SUPER_ADMIN`). Replaces assigned roles on a user and immediately rotates their SecurityStamp.
Requires `users:manage`. Sets assigned warehouses and optional default warehouse for Warehouse Keepers / Sales Reps and rotates SecurityStamp.
Requires `permissions:manage`. Lists all canonical and custom ERP roles and their permission claims.
Requires `permissions:manage`. Replaces permission claims for a role (e.g. roleId 3 = `SALES_MGR`) and rotates security stamps of all affected users.

item.name: 03 - Customers & Credit Grades
item.description: Customer onboarding, dynamic credit grades (A/B/C/D), and live credit-status lookups.

request.description: Requires `customers:view`. Returns seeded grades A (90d), B (60d), C (30d), D (0d Cash Only).
Requires `settings:manage`. Updates dynamic payment days and credit allowance per grade code (A..D).
Requires `customers:manage`. `category` must be `Market`, `Store`, `Restaurant`, `Supermarket`, or `Wholesale`. `vatNumber` if supplied must be exactly 15 digits. Saves `{{customerId}}`.

item.name: 07 - Sales Orders & Approval Workflow
item.description: Order submission (MR-01/MR-02/MR-03/RISK-01/RISK-03), manager edit, price override, credit co-approval, approval/rejection, and shipment invoicing.

request.description: Requires `orders:create` and `X-Idempotency-Key` GUID header. Evaluates tier/floor pricing, 24h soft stock reservation, shortage warnings, and credit-limit co-approval flags. Saves `{{orderId}}` and `{{orderItemId}}`.
Requires `customers:view`. Automatically row-scoped for Sales Reps and Warehouse Keepers.
Requires `orders:edit_submitted` (Sales Manager / Super Admin only; Sales Reps receive 403). Reconciles reserved stock delta and records old/new audit snapshot.
Requires `orders:override_price`. Clears pending below-tier/below-floor price override flags.
Requires `orders:coapprove_credit` (Accountant / Exec / Super Admin). Call only when `requiresFinanceCoApproval` is `true` (returns 422 if order does not require co-approval).
Requires `orders:approve`. Fails with 422 if credit co-approval, price override, or stock shortage is unresolved.
Requires `orders:approve`. Rejects a PendingApproval/Approved order and releases soft-reserved stock.

Requires `warehouse:ship` and `X-Idempotency-Key` GUID header. Ensure EGS device is registered in Folder 08 first! Deducts stock, appends `SalesShipment`, increments ZATCA ICV/PIH, builds TLV QR, and debits customer. Saves `{{invoiceId}}`.

item.name: 08 - ZATCA Invoices, Returns & Delivery
item.description: EGS device registration, ZATCA invoice print payload, paper copy upload, credit note returns (381), and delivery POD.

request.description: Requires `settings:manage`. Run before Confirm Shipment! Initializes ICV=0 and initial PIH (`SHA256("0")`). Saves `{{egsDeviceId}}`.
Requires `invoices:view`. Returns invoice totals, ZATCA ICV/UUID/PIH/XML hash, TLV Base64 QR, customer info, and lines.

item.name: Upload Signed Paper Invoice Copy URL

request.description: Requires `invoices:upload_copy`. Attaches scanned/stamped copy storage URL.
Requires `delivery:dispatch`. Assigns one or more invoices to a driver/rep. Saves `{{dispatchId}}`.
Requires `delivery:update_pod`. `deliveryStatus`: `PreparedAtWarehouse`, `OutForDelivery`, `Delivered`, or `FailedAttempt`.

item.name: Create Sales Return / ZATCA Credit Note (381)

request.description: Requires `sales:returns`. Issues ZATCA Credit Note with next monotonic ICV, credits customer balance, and restocks sellable units (`isSellableRestock: true`).

item.name: Record Cash Collection into Rep Custody (Idempotent)

request.description: Requires `collections:create` and `X-Idempotency-Key` GUID. Posts balanced journal (`DR RepCustodyWallet / CR AccountsReceivable`). Saves `{{cashCollectionId}}`.
Requires `collections:create`. Marks receipt as confirmed by customer.

item.name: Confirm Treasury Handover (Rep Custody -> Main Safe)

request.description: Requires `finance:confirm_treasury`. Moves funds from `RepCustodyWallet` to `MainTreasurySafe` with a balanced journal entry.

item.name: Submit Bank Transfer Proof (Idempotent + SHA-256 Dedupe)

request.description: Requires `collections:create` and `X-Idempotency-Key` GUID. `paymentProofImageHash` must be a unique 64-char SHA-256 hex digest (reusing returns `409 Conflict`). Saves `{{bankCollectionId}}`.
Requires `finance:verify_bank`. Posts balanced journal (`DR BankAccount / CR AccountsReceivable`), credits customer, and preserves `originalValueDateUtc`.
Requires `dashboards:finance`. Returns immutable balanced journal entries (`SUM(Debit) == SUM(Credit)`).
Requires `finance:close_period`. Locks the fiscal period so any further postings in that month fail with HTTP 422.

item.name: 10 - Dashboards, Audit Logs & GPS
item.description: Executive KPIs, role-scoped dashboards, immutable audit trail, and field rep GPS telemetry.

request.description: Requires `dashboards:executive`. Aggregates main safe, rep custody, bank balance, receivables, payables, and inventory valuation.
Requires `dashboards:sales`. Supported views: `sales`, `inventory`, `warehouse`, `finance`, `rep`.
Requires `dashboards:inventory`.
Requires `dashboards:finance`.
Requires `audit:view`. Filterable by `entityName`, `userId`, and `cursor` (last returned `id`).
Requires `gps:stream` (assigned to `SALES_REP` role). Accepts up to 100 pings per batch with Latitude [-90..90] and Longitude [-180..180].
